=================== Release 00222.11 ================================
This Release Notes file covers these blobs:
 * tz.mbn
 * tz_oem_config.mbn
 * tz_qti_config.mbn

Version : 00222.11

Release Date : Dec 22, 2025

Supported Silicon : x1p42100

Changes since last version :
 * ADSP/CDSP PIL support
 * TA load
 * Enable CL5 and SS3 LPMs
 * NOC error enablement
 * Enable SMMU functionality
